_doc.units: panel units; figure and portrait points are in their frame units
_doc.layers: rect is the panel area the texture covers; px = texture pixels per unit (scale a layer by scale_d / px); lit layers are not shaded by the darkness. Layers and figures draw strictly by depth (a figure at its anchor depth + 0.001), ties in list order, so light falling from a far window to the floor comes as two lit layers that cross-fade (chapel beam + pool, belfry shafts + pools)
_doc.glass_legend: three glass tiles (glass_a/b/c, one lancet each, x 0/800/1600) and four mullion tiles, so every texture is at most 4096 px wide; tiles of one depth move together
_doc.lights: depth = the layer a light rides on; kind flame/cold draws a Glow flame of height h at p; glow is a darkness light only; eyes: pts (the two eyes), dot, color, and h (their size: 5.2 h apart); hidden: true = no flame; color (= tint) = the light colour
_doc.anchors: p = where the figure feet go; h overrides the figure h; figures are drawn facing right and flip mirrors one about its feet, its flame and eye points too (x -> 2 feet.x - x); face is the actor facing hint
_doc.figures: flames {name: [x, y, h, kind, color?]} in frame units (base of the flame, height; eyes: the point between them and their size, 5.2 h apart); a figure at anchor A lights A.name; light.name gives the exact look: kind, r (frame units), s, color, pts and dot (eyes)
_doc.portraits: flame [x, y, h] in the 128 frame: the first mood's first live flame, left out when there is none; flames lists every live flame, mood_flames overrides it per mood; h is the full flame height; the dialogue box crops the frame to the circle of radius 0.42 (53.8 units) around (64, 62)

glass_legend.tiles: glass_a/b/c are the three lancets side by side (x 0, 800, 1600); mullions m0..m3 stand at x 0, 800, 1600, 2400
